newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly stronger, except fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly stronger, except fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly stronger on Monday apart from fuel oil which was flat, traders said.
Gas oil rose, tracking futures, but premiums were barely steady amid signs of growing supplies.

Naphtha edged up boosted by petrochemical demand and tight supply, with cargoes up $1 to $229/$231 cif NWE. Gasoline rose with firmer crude futures and tight supply. Traders noted strength ahead of the U.K. government's budget on November 26. Fuel oil cargoes were flat although barges moved up $3 a tonne to $127-128 fob ARA in very thin trade.
